name: VoxelBlockyModelFluid
definition: A procedural model for flowing water with different levels, similar to Minecraft. Less data is precomputed; calculations are done by the mesher on every block update to avoid excessive precomputed variations.
summary: VoxelBlockyModelFluid is a procedural model that renders Minecraft-style flowing water by dynamically displacing mesh vertices to match neighbor heights, avoiding precomputed memory overhead.
